info.title: Performativ
info.description:
Welcome to the API documentation for Performativ.

The API is RESTful and designed to be easy to use and understand, with predictable resource-oriented URLs, standard HTTP status codes, and JSON-formatted responses.

tags.name: Advice Policies
tags.description:
Advice policies define the business rules governing an advice context's behavior. A policy is assigned when creating an advice context and controls which transitions and actions are permitted.

**Available policies:**

| Policy                         | Behavior                                                                                                                                                                          |
|--------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `default`                      | Permissive. Agreements not required for sessions. Signing envelope not required before submit-signing.                                                                             |
| `advisory_control_lifecycle`   | Strict. Agreements required before sessions. Signed agreement needed to activate a session. Member changes auto-revoke agreements. Signing envelope must be linked before submit-signing. |

Policies are read-only configuration — list and show only.

tags.name: Advice Contexts
tags.description:
An advice context is the top-level container for an advisory engagement. It groups people (members) under a specific policy and type (individual, couple, or group).

**Relationship to other entities:**
- Contains **members** (person + client pairs) via `/advice-contexts/{id}/members`
- Contains **advisory agreements** via `/advice-contexts/{contextId}/agreements`
- Contains **advice sessions** via `/advice-contexts/{contextId}/sessions`
- Governed by an **advice policy** that controls what is required (e.g. whether a signed agreement is needed before starting a session)

**Lifecycle:**

| Status      | Description                           | Transitions to        | Action endpoint                          |
|-------------|---------------------------------------|-----------------------|------------------------------------------|
| `active`    | Default on creation. Work in progress | `closed`, `cancelled` | `POST .../close`, `POST .../cancel`      |
| `closed`    | Engagement completed normally         | *(terminal)*          | —                                        |
| `cancelled` | Engagement cancelled before completion| *(terminal)*          | —                                        |

The context does **not** automatically update when child entities (agreements, sessions) progress — it is a passive container. Close or cancel it explicitly when the engagement is done.

tags.name: Advisory Agreements
tags.description:
An advisory agreement is a formal agreement between the advisor and the advice context members. Created under an advice context, it tracks the signing workflow from draft through to signed, expired, or revoked.

**Relationship to other entities:**
- Belongs to an **advice context** (created via `POST /advice-contexts/{contextId}/agreements`)
- Optionally linked to a **signing envelope** for external signing workflows
- Optionally references a **signed document** via `signed_document_id` when completing `mark-signed` (strict policy enforces this via the envelope)

**Lifecycle:**

    draft ──submit-signing──► pending_signature ──mark-signed──► signed ──expire──► expired
      │                              │                             │
      └──────────revoke──────────────┴─────────────revoke──────────┘──► revoked

| From                | To                  | Action endpoint                | Prerequisites                                                          |
|---------------------|---------------------|--------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `draft`             | `pending_signature` | `POST .../submit-signing`      | Strict policy: signing envelope must be linked                         |
| `draft`             | `revoked`           | `POST .../revoke`              | `reason` required                                                      |
| `pending_signature` | `signed`            | `POST .../mark-signed`         | Optional `signed_document_id`. Strict policy: envelope must have a signed document |
| `pending_signature` | `revoked`           | `POST .../revoke`              | `reason` required                                                      |
| `signed`            | `expired`           | `POST .../expire`              | —                                                                      |
| `signed`            | `revoked`           | `POST .../revoke`              | `reason` required                                                      |
| `expired`           | *(terminal)*        | —                              | —                                                                      |
| `revoked`           | *(terminal)*        | —                              | —                                                                      |

Use `POST .../report-signing-progress` to record progress metadata while in `pending_signature` (does not change status).

**Policy behavior:** Under `AdvisoryControlLifecyclePolicy`, member changes on the context automatically revoke active agreements.

tags.name: Advice Sessions
tags.description:
An advice session represents a single advisory meeting or interaction within an advice context. It tracks the session from creation through data preparation, active advising, signing, or abandonment.

**Relationship to other entities:**
- Belongs to an **advice context** (created via `POST /advice-contexts/{contextId}/sessions`)
- Under strict policy (`AdvisoryControlLifecyclePolicy`), a signed advisory agreement must exist before a session can be activated

**Lifecycle:**

    created ──data-ready──► data_ready ──activate──► active ──ready-to-sign──► ready_to_sign ──signed──► signed
       │                       │                       │                           │
       └───────────────────────┴───────────abandon─────┴───────────────────────────┘──► abandoned

| From            | To              | Action endpoint          | Prerequisites                              |
|-----------------|-----------------|--------------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| `created`       | `data_ready`    | `POST .../data-ready`    | —                                          |
| `created`       | `abandoned`     | `POST .../abandon`       | Optional `reason`                          |
| `data_ready`    | `active`        | `POST .../activate`      | Strict policy: signed agreement must exist |
| `data_ready`    | `abandoned`     | `POST .../abandon`       | Optional `reason`                          |
| `active`        | `ready_to_sign` | `POST .../ready-to-sign` | —                                          |
| `active`        | `abandoned`     | `POST .../abandon`       | Optional `reason`                          |
| `ready_to_sign` | `signed`        | `POST .../signed`        | —                                          |
| `ready_to_sign` | `abandoned`     | `POST .../abandon`       | Optional `reason`                          |
| `signed`        | *(terminal)*    | —                        | —                                          |
| `abandoned`     | *(terminal)*    | —                        | —                                          |

The `abandon` action is allowed even when the parent advice context is in a terminal state (wind-down scenario).

tags.name: Signing Envelopes
tags.description:
A signing envelope manages the document-signing workflow, typically for advisory agreements. It bundles source documents and signer parties, tracks signing status, and can be linked to an advisory agreement.

**Relationship to other entities:**
- Optionally linked **to** an advisory agreement via `signing_envelope_id`
- Contains **documents** (source and signed) via `/signing-envelopes/{id}/documents`
- Contains **parties** (signers) via `/signing-envelopes/{id}/parties`

**Lifecycle:**

    draft ──send──► sent ──► completed | declined | expired
      │               │
      └───void────────┘──► voided

| From        | To          | Action endpoint        | Prerequisites                               |
|-------------|-------------|------------------------|---------------------------------------------|
| `draft`     | `sent`      | `POST .../send`        | At least one source document and one signer  |
| `draft`     | `voided`    | `POST .../void`        | —                                            |
| `sent`      | `completed` | *(external callback)*  | All parties signed                           |
| `sent`      | `declined`  | *(external callback)*  | A party declined                             |
| `sent`      | `voided`    | `POST .../void`        | —                                            |
| `sent`      | `expired`   | *(external/scheduled)* | Envelope past expiry date                    |
| `completed` | *(terminal)*| —                      | —                                            |
| `declined`  | *(terminal)*| —                      | —                                            |
| `voided`    | *(terminal)*| —                      | —                                            |
| `expired`   | *(terminal)*| —                      | —                                            |

tags.name: Documents
tags.description:
Documents store files (PDFs, images, etc.) uploaded via S3 presigned URLs or direct upload. They serve multiple purposes across the platform — client files, reports, contracts, and advisory agreement documents.

**Key document types for the advice domain:**

| Type                         | Purpose                                                                        |
|------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `advisory_agreement`         | Unsigned agreement document                                                    |
| `advisory_agreement_signed`  | Signed agreement document (conventional type, not enforced by `mark-signed`)   |

Documents can be referenced by ID in advisory agreement actions (e.g. `signed_document_id` in `mark-signed`). The `signed_document_id` is optional — under strict policy, the signing envelope's documents are checked instead.

get.description:
Returns deliveries in chronological order (oldest first) for durable event processing.
Clients manage their own cursor — no server-side state is tracked.

**Important:** Without `since` or `after`, results start from the **oldest** delivery,
which may be days or weeks old. For new integrations, pass `since` with the current
timestamp on your first poll, then use the returned `cursor` for subsequent calls.

To browse recent deliveries in reverse-chronological order (newest first), use the
`GET .../webhook-deliveries` index endpoint instead, which supports sorting and filtering.

ADR-PAGE deviation: uses manual cursor (after/since) instead of cursorPaginate()
because standard cursor pagination doesn't support UUID or timestamp-based cursors
needed for the polling contract. This is an action endpoint, not a standard index.
get.summary: Poll webhook deliveries (forward stream)

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor: UUID of the last delivery you received. Returns deliveries created after this one.

parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Returns deliveries created at or after this time. Recommended for your first poll — pass the current time to start from now.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of deliveries to return (1–200, default 50).

parameters.description: When true, each delivery includes computed x-webhook-timestamp and x-webhook-signature headers for local verification.
